notes: CHK-001 spans two domains, so it uses two assertions (mst: o_apb_pruser/pbuser; slv: o_apb_pwakeup/pauser/pwuser), both incrementing fails_CHK_001. hits_CHK_001 counts mst-clock cycles only. The slv-domain hits go to a separate helper counter because a single always_ff cannot be clocked by both domains. Zero-width ports are [-1:0] (2 bits), so they are compared against '0.
